items.title: Buying on impulse
sentences: Online shopping has made it easier than ever to buy things on impulse, often late at night and with a single click.
Retailers are well aware of this, and many of them design their websites to make hesitation feel unnecessary.
Countdown timers, 'only two left' warnings and one-click payment buttons are typical examples of the strategy.
Consumer groups argue that such techniques put pressure on shoppers who would otherwise take time to compare prices.
Some countries have therefore introduced rules that require sellers to show the final price clearly and to allow a cooling-off period for returns.
Whether these measures will actually change people's habits, however, remains to be seen.

explanation.en: 'this' is impulse buying, 'the strategy' is the website design, 'such techniques' are the timers and buttons, 'therefore' reacts to the criticism, and 'these measures' are the new rules.
explanation.es: 'this' es la compra impulsiva, 'the strategy' es el diseño de las webs, 'such techniques' son los contadores y botones, 'therefore' reacciona a la crítica y 'these measures' son las nuevas normas.

note.es: Diseñar las webs para quitar dudas.
Contadores, avisos y botones de un clic.

note.en: Rules are a result of the criticism.
note.es: Las normas son consecuencia de la crítica.

note.en: The new rules on prices and returns.
note.es: Las nuevas normas sobre precios y devoluciones.
